2607.00895.title: Beyond Document Grounding: Span-Level Hallucination Detection over Code, Tool Output, and Documents
2607.00895.paper_summary: Hallucination detection for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is usually evaluated on natural-language document evidence. However, grounded generation systems increasingly rely on structured inputs: source code, developer-tool output, markdown documents, tables, and repository metadata. We introduce a unified benchmark for span-level hallucination detection over code, tool output, structured documents, and existing natural-language RAG datasets. The benchmark is built by starting from grounded correct answers, injecting localized hallucinations with exact character labels, and validating the code test split with evidence-based review. Our fine-tuned Qwen3.5-2B detector reaches 0.689 span-F1 on the unified test set and 0.60 on the code-agent source, where it substantially outperforms LettuceDetect-large (0.17) and the strongest zero-shot LLM judges we evaluated (at most 0.22). The same model remains competitive on established natural-language benchmarks, with 81.8 RAGTruth example-F1 and 0.724 English PsiloQA IoU.
2607.00895.paper_summary_zh: 對於增強檢索生成（RAG）的幻覺檢測，通常是在自然語言文檔證據上進行評估。<lb/>然而，基於實體的生成系統越來越依賴結構化輸入：源代碼、開發工具輸出、Markdown 文檔、表格和倉庫元數據。<lb/>我們介紹了一個統一的基準，用於對代碼、工具輸出、結構化文檔和現有自然語言 RAG 數據集進行範圍級幻覺檢測。<lb/>該基準是從基於實體的正確答案開始，注入帶有精確字符標籤的局部幻覺，並通過基於證據的審查來驗證代碼測試拆分而建立的。<lb/>我們微調的 Qwen3.5-2B 檢測器在統一測試集上達到 0.689 的範圍-F1，在代碼代理源上達到 0.60，顯著超越了 LettuceDetect-large（0.17）和我們評估的最強零-shot LLM 評審（最多 0.22）。<lb/>同一模型在既定的自然語言基準上仍然具有競爭力，RAGTruth 範例-F1 為 81.8，英語 PsiloQA IoU 為 0.724。
